METALWORK — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: METALWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Career Opportunities in Metalwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Opportunities in Metalwork.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.

2. When learning Project 2, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Project 2.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 2.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project 2.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 2.

3. When learning Gas Welding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Gas Welding.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Gas Welding.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Gas Welding.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Gas Welding.

4. When learning Project 1, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 1.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 1.

   D. Skip safety briefings for Project 1.

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. CPU

6. When learning Heat treatment of steel, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Heat treatment of steel.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Heat treatment of steel.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Heat treatment of steel.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Heat treatment of steel.

7. When learning Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.

8. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

9. When learning Surface Finishing Processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Surface Finishing Processes.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Surface Finishing Processes.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Surface Finishing Processes.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Surface Finishing Processes.

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

11. When learning Assembly Drawings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly Drawings.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly Drawings.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly Drawings.

12. When learning Centre La, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Centre La.

   C. Skip safety briefings for Centre La.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Centre La.

13. When learning Forging, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Forging.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Forging.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Forging.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Forging.

14. When learning Metalwork related businesses, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metalwork related businesses.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metalwork related businesses.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Metalwork related businesses.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metalwork related businesses.

15. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Gas Welding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Forging and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Surface Finishing Processes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
